target_scope: at least 465 executed trades combined across nine independent cases
calibration: Causal rolling Beta(1,1) histogram of directional correctness
fallback: All prior 300 non-flat predictions if bin has fewer than 20; probability 0.5 if total support below 20
leverage_probability_constraint: All exposure levels use the same directional probability; exposure does not change price direction
embargo: Most recent calibration outcome exits strictly before the current entry bar
refit: Counts update with each newly completed past observation; no future labels
stopping_rule: Process 128 next chronological signals per active case per round; stop at the end of the first full round with >=465 executions, or exhausted data
accounts: Independent 100000 quote-currency accounts; combined count is not a pooled chronological portfolio
costs: Unchanged: per-fill 10/5/2 bps, annual financing 8% above 1x, short borrow 3%
confidence_event: Model median direction is correct at the next close; exact zero movement is not a success
profit_probability: Separate diagnostic: estimate positive net P&L at each exposure; never relabel it directional confidence
raw_score: Quantile-CDF probability that price moves in the median-predicted direction
methodology_change: Explicit event-definition redesign after observing trade scarcity; neither old frozen calibration nor a clean untouched study
